summary: Experienced boatman Matt Clemente of New Castle was on a family drift-boat trip on the Colorado River near New Castle when the boat hit a large wave at the Dino Hole rapid, filled with water and flipped; Clemente, not wearing a PFD, drowned. His brother and raft guides rescued his three children; a Garfield County SAR team of eight members with two watercraft located his body on a sandbar near the New Castle boat ramp Saturday evening, and it was retrieved by helicopter around 7:35 p.m.
location: Colorado River, Dino Hole, near New Castle
notes: American Whitewater accident record (parent-opened), embedding the Garfield County Post Independent article of June 25, 2024; accident_date 2024-06-22 in the AW record and 'on Saturday' in the PI article (June 22, 2024 was a Saturday). Run 1021 chunk C.
